parsed.rationale: Although the two types share structural shape (both are `type-alias-object` with `shared_field_count: 1` and no declared fields), they carry distinct names — `TextHeightPreferenceKey` in `app:WatchXYC` (`WatchXYC/PlayerPage.swift:140`) and `ScrollOffsetPreferenceKey` in `app:iOS` (`iOS/Views/Playlist/Playcut Detail/PlaycutRowView.swift:74`) — and live in entirely separate platform targets (watchOS vs. iOS). SwiftUI `PreferenceKey` boilerplate is inherently minimal and identical in shape across all conformers; the coincidence is structural, not semantic. Merging or extracting them would couple two unrelated UI concerns across platform boundaries without meaningful reduction in complexity.
